name: Kubernetes Dynamic Resource Allocation with structured device claims
core_change: Moves specialized-device requests from opaque plugin-era counts toward class/claim/slice APIs and scheduler-visible structured matching.
compiler_implications: Represent device requests as capability predicates and alternatives.
Bind ResourceClaim, allocation result and driver preparation as distinct phases.
Probe exact Kubernetes/driver feature maturity.
maturity: core API GA in Kubernetes 1.34; extensions vary
caveats: A DRA claim is still not a provider-neutral semantic resource class without ACL translation.

name: Partitionable devices and consumable device capacity
core_change: Allows devices to expose partitions and capacity that multiple independent claims can consume rather than all-or-nothing device counts.
compiler_implications: Resource classes need parent/partition identity and capacity counters.
Allocation must prove no counter oversubscription and model shared-engine interference.
caveats: Capacity sharing does not establish performance isolation.

name: In-place workload CPU and memory resize
core_change: Separates resource-rights changes from destructive workload replacement for supported CPU/memory updates.
compiler_implications: Add resize intent, proposed/accepted/realized resource vectors and transition receipts.
Distinguish restart-required from in-place realizable changes.
caveats: Not all resources or container/runtime combinations resize in place.

name: Queueing and quota-reservation layer for batch workloads
core_change: Makes workload admission, resource flavors, quota borrowing, fair sharing and preemption explicit above pod placement.
compiler_implications: Compile admission separately from placement.
Model LocalQueue, ClusterQueue, Cohort and ResourceFlavor through provider-neutral ACLs.
caveats: Admission does not mean physical scheduling completion.

name: Hierarchical topology-aware all-or-nothing batch scheduling
core_change: Adds rack/block/host topology domains and group-level capacity checks for communication-sensitive jobs.
compiler_implications: Topology graph must carry hierarchy and freshness.
Support role/slice indexed gang constraints and placement receipts.
caveats: Label accuracy and network-performance assumptions require evidence.

name: Coordinated JobSet lifecycle and failure policy
core_change: Models multiple replicated jobs as one coordinated runtime workload with dependency, success and failure policies.
compiler_implications: Preserve logical JobSet, child job and attempt identities.
Compile failure rules and restart scope rather than one generic retry count.
maturity: Kubernetes SIG project; API version evolving
caveats: Business workflow semantics remain outside runtime ownership.

name: Dynamically loadable safe-fallback Linux schedulers through sched_ext/eBPF
core_change: Opens the host CPU-scheduler policy surface to BPF programs with runtime diagnostics and fail-safe fallback.
compiler_implications: Treat host scheduler policy as a target capability/offer.
Require fallback, watchdog, diagnostics and policy-version receipts.
maturity: merged Linux facility with evolving scheduler ecosystem
caveats: Host CPU policy is not cluster scheduling and needs workload-specific validation.

name: Production-oriented data-access monitoring and access-aware memory operations
core_change: Provides lightweight scalable access-pattern observation and policy-driven memory actions.
compiler_implications: Expose access-observation method and uncertainty.
Bind memory-tier/reclaim policy independently from application semantics.
caveats: Access frequency is not business value or safe eviction proof.

name: Multi-generational LRU page reclaim
core_change: Uses access generations, tiers and feedback to improve page reclaim under pressure.
compiler_implications: Target profile should report reclaim mechanism where it affects latency/capacity models.
Do not encode kernel reclaim policy as application-level guarantee.
caveats: Benefit is workload/kernel specific.

name: CXL 3.x fabric and memory pooling
core_change: Extends coherent interconnect toward switched fabrics, pooled/shared memory and composable resource topologies.
compiler_implications: Topology and resource identity can no longer assume memory belongs permanently to one host.
Model attach/detach, pooling, latency tier, failure domain and fencing.
caveats: Specification capability is not evidence that a deployed fabric supports every feature.

name: UCIe 2.0 chiplet manageability and telemetry architecture
core_change: Adds standardized package-level management transport, discovery, telemetry/debug and QoS channels across chiplets.
compiler_implications: Hardware-resource topology may include package/chiplet identities and manageability evidence.
Keep package telemetry separate from cluster allocation.
caveats: Package-level resource management is below the platform scheduler boundary.

name: WASI 0.2 on the WebAssembly Component Model
core_change: Rebases WASI on typed WIT component interfaces and canonical ABI for cross-language composition.
compiler_implications: Compile imported effects/capabilities as explicit requirements.
Bind WIT world, component ABI and runtime conformance by exact edition.
maturity: released interface milestone with uneven runtime coverage
caveats: Component portability does not automatically imply performance or host-capability parity.

name: OpenMP 6.0 heterogeneous parallel runtime surface
core_change: Advances standardized host/task/target parallel programming and tooling interfaces.
compiler_implications: Treat offload/task features as exact target capabilities.
Emit implementation-coverage gaps rather than assuming compiler support.
caveats: Specification publication is not target conformance evidence.

name: MPI 4.1 standard refinement after MPI-4 sessions and persistent operations
core_change: Consolidates MPI-4 era interfaces and clarifications for scalable session-oriented distributed runtimes.
compiler_implications: Model session/member-set edition separately from process rank.
Target profile must enumerate supported MPI features and failure behavior.
caveats: Portable fault tolerance remains incomplete and implementation-dependent.

name: OCI Image/Distribution 1.1 artifact references and referrers API
core_change: Standardizes linking metadata artifacts such as attestations and SBOM-like objects to content-addressed subjects.
compiler_implications: Execution artifacts can require evidence artifacts by subject digest.
Runtime binding validates artifact graph without treating it as resource allocation.
caveats: Registry support and fallback behavior vary.

name: FOCUS provider-neutral cost and usage specification
core_change: Creates a normalized cross-provider vocabulary/schema for billing and usage data.
compiler_implications: Bind runtime usage receipts to billing records through explicit reconciliation.
Preserve list/contracted/effective/billed cost distinctions and correction lineage.
caveats: FOCUS data is billing evidence, not real-time scheduling truth.

name: Software Carbon Intensity becomes ISO/IEC 21031
core_change: Standardizes a rate-based methodology combining operational and embodied emissions for a software boundary and functional unit.
compiler_implications: Add energy/carbon measurement method, boundary and functional unit to resource plans.
Reject carbon-aware ranking when comparable inputs do not close.
caveats: Input attribution and carbon-intensity choices remain uncertain and context-dependent.

name: eBPF-based workload energy attribution with Kepler
core_change: Exposes process/container-oriented energy estimates and hardware readings as observable metrics.
compiler_implications: Treat attribution as versioned model evidence with uncertainty.
Reconcile workload estimates to host measurements before optimization claims.
caveats: Accuracy and supported counters vary by platform/model.

name: Joint logical and physical resource disaggregation
core_change: Research reframes resources as independently demanded and fabric-attached rather than fixed server-shaped slots.
compiler_implications: Do not make machine type the primitive compiler demand.
Represent resource vectors, topology costs and allocation horizons independently.
caveats: Remote-resource latency/locality and failure behavior prevent transparent equivalence in general.

name: Eviction-aware serverless execution on harvested resources
core_change: Demonstrates cost/throughput gains from scheduling functions on variable spare capacity using eviction-aware control.
compiler_implications: Interruptibility, eviction rate and checkpoint/retry costs belong in offers.
Cost-aware selection must retain risk and SLO constraints.
caveats: Results do not generalize without workload and provider revalidation.
